findings.evidence: a02-s003「three paces apart」、a02-s007「three paces away beyond the anvil」、a02-s011「about three paces apart」、a02-s050「Nie standing at the anvil and Liu sitting on the sand three paces apart」、a02-s054「three paces of grey sand between them」（Nie 走過去跪在 Liu 旁邊，Liu 沒動）；a02-s063「Liu sitting cross-legged on the sand at the anvil's left side, one pace away」、a02-s069「one pace of grey sand and the ash-filmed anvil between them」；修訂後 a03-s002「a pace back from the anvil」、a03-s008「two paces apart」。分場表第四節：「兩人隔著鐵砧與一盆炭火約三步」。
findings.fix: 以多數鏡與分場表的三步為準，改四個字串：a02-s063「one pace away」→「three paces away」；a02-s069「one pace of grey sand」→「three paces of grey sand」；a03-s002「a pace back from the anvil, leaning away from it」→「three paces back from the anvil, leaning away from it」；a03-s008「two paces apart」→「three paces apart」。秒數不變。
